answers.core: It is quite a small addition (in terms of performance impact and user experience, I can't say if it's easy to implement), and a there are a number of people who want more control in the lighting shader, while I haven't seen this specific request I think it would help with a lot of stylised or specialised lighting scenarios.
answers.workaround: Not easily, I've been experimenting for a while and my current solution is to render two viewports, one with albedo and one with just lighting, and composite them.  This of course affect performance.  There may be a better solution but I haven't found it yet.

title: Add light count and light index builtins to light shader
